title: Improve JSON parsing performance
description:
Simply by using the underlying function `parse_json()` from `jsonlite` rather than the wrapper function `fromJSON()`.

It's a free lunch, as it simply skips the expensive detection of whether the supplied string is a filename or not (never in our case).

Unfortunately, the equivalent `asJSON()` is internal and not exported.
